component.name: Phone Kompanion
component.summary: Calls, phone apps and SMS on your computer, next to KDE Connect

description.p: Phone Kompanion works alongside KDE Connect and uses the phones paired there. It adds what KDE Connect does not do by itself:

ul.li: Phone calls over Bluetooth: answer, decline and make calls with the call audio on the computer, with a dialer, call notifications and the contacts KDE Connect syncs
The phone's screen, its apps and its camera in windows on the computer, with scrcpy and Wireless debugging; apps can be added to the application menu, and the camera can be used as a webcam
The SMS conversations KDE Connect syncs, in the same window
Entries in the system tray and in KRunner, a command line tool, and tel: and sms: links

screenshot.caption: A phone's page, and the dialer searching the contacts
The phones from KDE Connect, and what each one offers

description.p: The app no longer fails to start after a Qt update.
Packages for Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu and openSUSE Leap 16, a README and screenshots.
